units.source_text: 真一到祇园社去接受五位少将官衔时，千重子跟着去了。

en.t: When Shinichi went to Gion Shrine to receive the rank of Fifth-Rank Minor Captain, Chieko went along with him.

units.source_text: 彩车游街，她也跟着转悠。

en.t: When the festival floats paraded through the streets, she wandered along after them too.

units.source_text: 童男打扮的真一，带着两个小侍从来到千重子的店铺拜访，

en.t: Shinichi, dressed as a sacred child, came to visit Chieko's shop with two young attendants,

units.source_text: 千重子满脸通红地凝望着真一。

en.t: Chieko gazed at Shinichi, her whole face flushed bright red.

units.source_text: 真一化了妆，抹上了口红，然而千重子却是一副被晒黑了的脸。

en.t: Shinichi wore makeup and had lipstick on, while Chieko's face was tanned by the sun.

units.source_text: 那时千重子还是个小姑娘，身穿夏季单衣，腰系三尺红色腰带，

en.t: At that time Chieko was still a little girl, wearing an unlined summer kimono with a three-foot red sash tied around her waist,

units.source_text: 把折凳放倒，靠在红格子门上，在同邻居的孩子玩线香花火……

en.t: setting a folding stool on its side, leaning against the red lattice door, and playing with sparklers with the neighborhood children...
